title: Geekvape Wenax Q Pro Pod Vape Kit
description: The Geek Vape Wenax Q Pro Vape Kit is the latest innovation in the Wenax series, offering a sleek, compact design packed with advanced features. Powered by a 1200mAh built-in battery, this device supports adjustable wattage up to 30W, making it perfect for both MTL (mouth-to-lung) and RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) vaping styles. The Wenax Q Pro is equipped with a crisp, clear 0.96” smart colour screen, displaying Geek Vape’s Aurora UI and essential information like wattage, coil resistance, and battery life, with smart animations. The Wenax Q Pro also features advanced haptic feedback, providing vibration alerts for key functions like low battery and coil detection. The 1200mAh battery supports fast USB Type-C charging, ensuring minimal downtime between vaping sessions. The kit includes a 2ml pod that utilizes the Geek Vape Q Pod system, ensuring excellent flavour and vapour production. The Wenax Q Pro is compatible with both MTL and RDL Q cartridges, offering versatility to suit your vaping preference. The top-fill design ensures mess-free refills, and the pods are designed to be leak-resistant, making this device ideal for on-the-go vaping. This kit includes 2 x 2ml top-fill Wenax Q pods equipped with Geek Vape's advanced VPU technology, enhancing flavour delivery and coil longevity. The Wenax Q Pro is compatible with Geek Vape Q series cartridges, providing flexibility and customisability with multiple coil resistance options. Available in a variety of stylish colours, the Wenax Q Pro is the ideal choice for vapers seeking a portable, feature-rich vape kit. Check out our vape juice and pair it perfectly with this kit. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
